columns.name: is_revenue_eligible
columns.description: Parent order verdict, not line eligibility. True for resolved revenue scope with verified full payment; false for any proven exclusion; null when required evidence is unknown without a proven exclusion. Does not apply AOV exclusions.

columns.name: revenue_exclusion_reasons
columns.description: Parent order reasons. All proven exclusion identifiers separated and terminated by a pipe; empty when none. Identifiers are test_order, gift_card_only and payment_not_fully_collected.

columns.name: revenue_unresolved_requirements
columns.description: Parent order requirements. All unresolved requirement identifiers separated and terminated by a pipe; empty when none. Identifiers are test_status_unknown, payment_evidence_incomplete, payment_obligation_unknown, payment_chronology_unresolved and commercial_value_unknown. Retained even for excluded orders.

columns.name: is_aov_eligible
columns.description: Parent whole-order AOV verdict, not a line count or average: true only for verified paid, commercially resolved merchandise scope with known non-gifted, non-replacement, non-exchange classification, no cancellation or full refund and positive net revenue excluding tax and handling fees. False for a proven exclusion; null for unresolved requirements.

columns.name: aov_exclusion_reasons
columns.description: Parent order AOV exclusions, pipe-separated and terminated; empty when none. Includes revenue exclusions plus cancelled_order, gifted_order, replacement_order, exchange_order, fully_refunded and nonpositive_commercial_value.

columns.name: aov_unresolved_requirements
columns.description: Parent order unknown AOV requirements, retained even for excluded orders. Includes revenue requirements plus revenue_evidence_missing, gifting_status_unknown, replacement_status_unknown, exchange_status_unknown, refund_status_unknown and retained_commercial_value_unknown; pipe-separated and terminated.

columns.name: is_asp_eligible
columns.description: Line ASP verdict: true only for resolved paid merchandise scope, known net quantity and line sales/discount/refund allocations, with no test, cancellation, gifting, replacement or exchange exclusion. Amount-only full refunds and zero-unit residual values remain eligible. False for proven exclusion; null when required evidence is unknown.

columns.name: asp_exclusion_reasons
columns.description: All proven ASP exclusions, pipe-separated and terminated. Includes shared revenue and parent cancellation/gifting/replacement/exchange exclusions plus gift_card_item. Does not inherit AOV full-refund or positive-value requirements.

columns.name: asp_unresolved_requirements
columns.description: All unknown ASP requirements, retained even for excluded lines; pipe-separated and terminated. Includes shared parent payment/commercial/classification requirements plus parent_eligibility_missing, gift_card_status_unknown, net_quantity_unknown and line_commercial_value_unknown.

description: Shopify orders at their latest known state, one row per order. Includes test and cancelled orders. Source totals keep Shopify's meanings; governed revenue measures are not yet defined here. Adds USD commercial components and explicit unresolved evidence; net revenue excludes finalized fees. Channel and order-characteristic flags are nullable; null means the evidence is unavailable.
grain: One row per Shopify order, latest known state

columns.name: is_payment_observation_complete
columns.description: Whether parent observation lineage is present at revision 3 or later and its EXACT transaction count matches the retained transaction rows. Does not prove freshness or source-window coverage.

columns.name: is_payment_obligation_verified
columns.description: Whether one dated initial ORDER and supported dated changes reconcile to original and current order totals in USD using the validated ledger handling-fee header adjustment. Event obligations retain those fees. Unsupported RETURN agreements remain false.

columns.name: is_payment_chronology_resolved
columns.description: Whether cash movements are classified, amounts and times are usable, refund links resolve to one agreement, and chronological retained cash never becomes negative.

columns.name: has_fully_paid_current_obligation
columns.description: Whether net cash covers a verified obligation at a logical event on or after the latest order edit. Later refunds preserve proof; a new unpaid edit resets it. Null for incomplete proof.

columns.name: net_customer_payment_shop_amount
columns.description: Successful collections less customer refunds, excluding proven failed-attempt reversal pairs; null when observation or chronology is unresolved.

columns.name: is_partially_refunded
columns.description: Whether successful customer refunds exist with positive net retained payment; null for unresolved observation or payment chronology.

columns.name: is_fully_refunded
columns.description: Whether previous collections and successful customer refunds leave zero net retained payment; null for unresolved observation or payment chronology.

columns.name: is_revenue_eligible
columns.description: True for resolved revenue scope with verified full payment; false for any proven exclusion; null when required evidence is unknown without a proven exclusion. Does not apply AOV exclusions.

columns.name: revenue_unresolved_requirements

Identifiers are test_status_unknown, payment_evidence_incomplete, payment_obligation_unknown, payment_chronology_unresolved and commercial_value_unknown. Retained even for excluded orders.

columns.name: is_aov_eligible
columns.description: Whole-order AOV verdict: true only for verified paid, commercially resolved merchandise scope with known non-gifted, non-replacement, non-exchange classification, no cancellation or full refund and positive net revenue excluding tax and handling fees. columns.name: aov_exclusion_reasons
columns.description: All proven AOV exclusions, pipe-separated and terminated; empty when none. Includes revenue exclusions plus cancelled_order, gifted_order, replacement_order, exchange_order, fully_refunded and nonpositive_commercial_value.

columns.name: aov_unresolved_requirements

columns.description: Shopify totalShippingPriceSet: shipping charged, after shipping discounts. Null for observations before extraction revision 2. In shop currency (USD).

columns.name: total_shipping_price_presentment_amount
columns.description: Shopify totalShippingPriceSet: shipping charged, after shipping discounts. Null for observations before extraction revision 2. In presentment currency.

columns.name: total_refunded_shop_amount
columns.description: Shopify totalRefundedSet: total amount refunded, including tax. A reconciliation input, not a commercial refund measure. In shop currency (USD).

columns.name: total_refunded_presentment_amount
columns.description: Shopify totalRefundedSet: total amount refunded, including tax. A reconciliation input, not a commercial refund measure. In presentment currency.

columns.name: line_count
columns.description: Number of source order lines, including removed and refunded lines. Zero when the order has no lines.

columns.name: gross_ordered_quantity
columns.description: Units ordered across all lines before cancellations, removals and refunds.

columns.name: original_line_value_shop_amount
columns.description: Sum of quantity times original unit price across lines, before any discounts, edits or refunds. Not gross sales. In shop currency (USD).

columns.name: original_line_value_presentment_amount
columns.description: original_line_value in presentment currency.

columns.name: source_observed_at
columns.description: When ingestion last observed this order in Shopify, in UTC.

columns.name: has_classification_evidence
columns.description: True when the latest observation selected tags, discount codes and order email (extraction revision 2 or later). False means tag, code and email rules are unknown, so channel and characteristic flags that need them are null.

columns.name: has_retail_evidence
columns.description: Retail rule match. True when the trimmed, lowercased source name is pos.

columns.name: has_specialty_evidence
columns.description: Specialty rule match, kept even when retail wins. True for a tag matching the specialty_order_tags project var or a discount code matching specialty_discount_codes. Null without classification evidence.

columns.name: has_bulk_evidence
columns.description: Bulk rule match, kept even when retail or specialty wins. True for a tag matching bulk_order_tags. Null without classification evidence.

columns.name: has_gifting_tag_evidence
columns.description: True for a tag matching gifting_order_tags. Null without classification evidence.

columns.name: is_d2c
columns.description: Direct-to-consumer channel, the residual of the commercial rules. True when retail, specialty and bulk were all evaluated with no match; false for commercial orders; null when commercial evidence is unavailable. Independent of revenue, refunds and metric eligibility.

columns.name: is_commercial
columns.description: True when the order is retail, specialty or bulk. Mutually exclusive with is_d2c; null when no commercial channel is established and evidence is unavailable.

columns.name: is_retail
columns.description: Retail commercial channel. Every Shopify POS order is retail; retail takes precedence over specialty and bulk.

columns.name: is_specialty
columns.description: Specialty commercial channel. True with specialty evidence and no retail match.

columns.name: is_bulk
columns.description: Bulk commercial channel. True with bulk evidence and no retail or specialty match.

columns.name: is_employee_order
columns.description: True when the order email domain is exactly one of the employee_email_domains project var, paid or free. Uses the order email, not the current customer profile. Null when the email is unavailable.

columns.name: is_gifted
columns.description: True for a gifting tag or a non-test, non-replacement employee order whose original whole-order total after discounts, including shipping and tax, is zero. Later edits or refunds do not establish gifting. Null when required evidence is unavailable or invalid and no decisive condition resolves the rule.

columns.name: is_replacement
columns.description: True for a tag matching replacement_order_tags or a discount code matching replacement_discount_codes.

columns.name: is_exchange
columns.description: True for a tag matching exchange_order_tags or a discount code matching exchange_discount_codes. Can overlap with is_replacement.

columns.name: is_shopify_collective
columns.description: True for a tag matching shopify_collective_order_tags. Collective orders are D2C unless a commercial rule matches.

columns.name: is_broadcast
columns.description: True for a tag matching broadcast_order_tags. Broadcast orders are D2C unless a commercial rule matches.

columns.name: net_ordered_quantity
columns.description: Units after source refunds/removals and additional unfulfilled cancellation removal. Null when required evidence is unknown; not physically kept units.

columns.name: unresolved_quantity_line_count
columns.description: Source lines with unknown net quantity. A positive count makes the order net quantity null.

columns.name: commercial_resolution_status
columns.description: First blocking reason, or complete. Values are no_agreement_evidence, no_order_agreement, no_sale_evidence, unresolved_sales, unresolved_refund, unfinalized_fee, unresolved_adjustment, unresolved_payment_refund, unresolved_payment_currency and complete.

columns.name: is_commercial_resolved
columns.description: Whether commercial_resolution_status is complete.

columns.name: agreement_count
columns.description: Number of sales agreements for the order.

columns.name: sale_count
columns.description: Number of ledger sales for the order.

columns.name: unresolved_sale_count
columns.description: Number of ledger sales that did not resolve.

columns.name: refund_object_count
columns.description: Number of Shopify refund objects for the order.

columns.name: refund_without_agreement_count
columns.description: Number of refund objects with no sales agreement carrying the same refund identity.

columns.name: refund_object_unresolved_count
columns.description: Number of refund objects that are not in USD or have no amount.

columns.name: unfinalized_fee_count
columns.description: Number of fee sales that need finalized Loop evidence.

columns.name: unresolved_adjustment_count
columns.description: Number of refund adjustments. Each one is unexplained until finalized evidence explains it.

columns.name: non_gift_card_line_count
columns.description: Number of source order lines that are not gift cards; a parent allocation input.

columns.name: unknown_gift_card_line_count
columns.description: Number of source order lines whose gift-card flag is missing.

columns.name: unresolved_refund_payment_count
columns.description: Number of successful refund transactions that are not yet classified.

columns.name: gross_merchandise_shop_amount
columns.description: Merchandise value before discount for the order; NULL when sales are not fully known.

columns.name: merchandise_discount_shop_amount
columns.description: Tax-exclusive merchandise discount for the order, as a negative effect.

columns.name: merchandise_refund_shop_amount
columns.description: Tax-exclusive merchandise refund for the order, net of discount, as a negative value.

columns.name: net_merchandise_shop_amount
columns.description: Gross merchandise plus discount plus merchandise refund; NULL unless the status is complete.

columns.name: shipping_shop_amount
columns.description: Tax-exclusive shipping charged for the order.

columns.name: shipping_refund_shop_amount
columns.description: Tax-exclusive shipping refunded for the order, as a negative value.

columns.name: net_shipping_shop_amount
columns.description: Shipping plus shipping refund; NULL unless the status is complete.

columns.name: net_revenue_shop_amount
columns.description: Net merchandise plus net shipping; NULL unless the status is complete. Excludes fees.

columns.name: duty_shop_amount
columns.description: Tax-exclusive duty sales for the order, signed as reported.

columns.name: gift_card_liability_shop_amount
columns.description: Tax-exclusive gift-card sale value for the order; excluded from merchandise.

columns.name: tax_shop_amount
columns.description: Source tax across resolved sales for the order.

columns.name: return_shipping_fee_shop_amount
columns.description: Tax-exclusive return shipping fee for the order.

columns.name: unfinalized_fee_shop_amount
columns.description: Tax-exclusive fee sales that need finalized Loop evidence. Not a handling fee.

columns.name: additional_fee_shop_amount
columns.description: Tax-exclusive additional fee sales for the order.

columns.name: unresolved_adjustment_shop_amount
columns.description: Sum of refund adjustment amounts in USD. Unexplained; not a merchandise, shipping or fee amount.

columns.name: unresolved_adjustment_tax_shop_amount
columns.description: Sum of refund adjustment tax amounts in USD. Unexplained.

columns.name: unassigned_shipping_shop_amount
columns.description: Shipping charged for the order with no direct line assignment; the parent allocates it.

columns.name: unassigned_shipping_refund_shop_amount
columns.description: Shipping refunded for the order with no direct line assignment; the parent allocates it.

columns.name: ledger_total_shop_amount
columns.description: Sum of resolved sale totals including tax; compare with the current order total.

columns.name: ledger_header_difference_shop_amount
columns.description: Ledger total minus the current order total in the source header. Zero means the ledger reconciles.

columns.name: refund_object_shop_amount
columns.description: Sum of refund object totals in USD for the order.

columns.name: refund_linked_sale_total_shop_amount
columns.description: Tax-inclusive sale totals on sales agreements that carry a refund identity.

columns.name: refund_agreement_difference_shop_amount
columns.description: Refund object total plus refund-linked sale totals. Zero means the refund objects match the agreements.

columns.name: successful_collected_shop_amount
columns.description: Successful collected payments for the order, including gift-card tender.

columns.name: successful_refund_object_payment_shop_amount
columns.description: Successful refund payments linked to a Shopify refund object.

columns.name: failed_attempt_reversal_shop_amount
columns.description: Successful refund payments identified as reversals of failed attempts; excluded from commercial refunds.

columns.name: unresolved_refund_payment_shop_amount
columns.description: Successful refund payments that are not yet classified; excluded from commercial refunds.

columns.name: reporting_currency_code
columns.description: Governed reporting currency for every amount in this model; always USD.

columns.name: unresolved_handling_fee_count
columns.description: Refunds whose handling-fee evidence remains unresolved.

columns.name: handling_fee_shop_amount
columns.description: Finalized handling fees in USD, separate from merchandise, shipping and net revenue. Unknown when any refund fee is unresolved.

columns.name: unresolved_payment_activity_count
columns.description: Unclassified payment activity or money movement with missing or negative amounts.

columns.name: payment_transaction_count
columns.description: Observed payment transactions; zero does not establish payment collection.

columns.name: merchandise_discount_unallocated_shop_amount
columns.description: Order discount not yet assigned to a line. NULL when unknown.

columns.name: merchandise_refund_unallocated_shop_amount
columns.description: Order merchandise refund not yet assigned to a line. NULL when unknown.

columns.name: shipping_unallocated_shop_amount
columns.description: Order shipping not yet assigned to a line. NULL when unknown.

columns.name: shipping_refund_unallocated_shop_amount
columns.description: Order shipping refund not yet assigned to a line. NULL when unknown.

columns.name: allocation_status
columns.description: First blocking reason, or complete.

columns.name: is_allocation_complete
columns.description: Whether every component is fully allocated.
